_style_preset: Photorealistic live-action Japanese drama, authentic contemporary Japanese hot-spring inn (温泉旅館) mise-en-scene, Reiwa era, Arri Alexa cinematic color grade, Kodak 35mm film grain, 24fps, 16:9, quiet elegant realism, no flat lighting

characters.prompt: Create ONE single photorealistic cinematic film still in 16:9 widescreen — one frame only, NOT a grid, no panels, no borders, no captions. REAL PHOTOGRAPH ONLY: a frame from a live-action Japanese drama shot on a cinema camera — real human skin with pores and fine lines, real fabric weave, real wood grain; NOT an illustration, NOT anime, NOT a painting, NOT CGI. EXPRESSION FIRST — the face must read clearly at a glance on a phone screen, at about 75 percent intensity, overriding the neutral expression of any reference image: Expression — DESPERATE PLEADING: inner brows pulled up and together forming a soft wrinkle between them, eyes wide and wet with the lower lids tensed, lips parted a little and trembling at one corner, chin dimpled, the whole face leaning slightly toward the listener. ACTING REALISM: this is a real actor caught mid-thought, not a posed portrait — a subtle NATURAL ASYMMETRY between the two sides of the face, the emotion held mainly in the EYES and the tiny muscles around them (lower eyelids, inner brows, nostrils, the corners of the mouth), the skin reacting (faint flush or pallor where the emotion demands), a believable breath in the chest; NO exaggerated theatrical grimace, NO stock smile with teeth, NO blank mannequin stare, NO perfectly symmetrical frozen face. Photorealistic live-action Japanese drama, authentic contemporary Japanese hot-spring inn (温泉旅館) mise-en-scene, Reiwa era, Arri Alexa cinematic color grade, Kodak 35mm film grain, 24fps, 16:9, quiet elegant realism, no flat lighting. LOCATION FIRST: the scene takes place in the location of reference image 2; the room, furniture and background of reference image 1 must NOT appear — only its face is used. [CAMERA] MOBILE-FIRST COMPOSITION: this will be watched on a 6-inch phone screen — the key subject (face, hand or object) is LARGE and centred in the middle 60 percent of the frame, high local contrast between subject and background, nothing important near the frame edges or in tiny far-off detail; the lower fifth of the frame stays visually simple (subtitles will sit there). FRAMING FIRST: a tight single-person chest-up close-up — head and shoulders fill the frame, the top of the head near the top edge, the frame cut at mid-chest; the face occupies about one third of the frame height; hands NOT visible; NOT a medium shot, NOT a full-body shot. Full-frame 16:9 image, no black bars. Mouth CLOSED (lips together, no teeth visible); facing the camera, looking into the lens. eye-level, 85mm prime lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, razor-sharp focus on the irises, soft optical bokeh, cinematic portrait. Exactly one person in sharp focus, no foreground shoulder, hands out of frame, chest-up single close-up, facing the camera within 30 degrees. [CHARACTER] Reference image 1 is the APPROVED keyframe face of this character: reproduce exactly this face, hair, eyewear and wardrobe; ignore its background and framing unless the description below says otherwise. Reference image 2 is the location reference: match its architecture, colours, set dressing and light direction; ignore any borders or labels. IDENTITY FIRST: the person is EXACTLY the one in reference image 1 — same face shape, jaw, cheekbones, nose, eyes, eyebrows, skin tone, age, hairstyle and eyewear; only the expression, lighting and framing described below change. Tomiko, a Japanese woman aged 62, lean face with high cheekbones, silver-grey hair in a tight formal upswept bun, thin gold-rimmed oval glasses, small pearl stud earrings, upright rigid posture, wearing a plain deep plum-purple silk kimono with no pattern, a plain pale gold obi, white tabi socks, no crest. [ACTION] Chest-up close-up of Tomiko in the small dim office at night, NO glasses on her face now, leaning forward toward the handset held to her ear just below the frame, the inner corners of her brows raised high and pinched together, eyes glossy and brimming with unshed tears that catch the lamp light, red-rimmed lids, mouth open mid-plea with the lower lip trembling, chin crumpling, one thin hand clutching the collar of her plum kimono, lamp light raking one side of her face, a proud old woman begging. TEARS RULE: tears must look like real human tears — eyes brimming with a thin film of water that pools along the lower lids and catches a tiny highlight, the eye rims and the tip of the nose slightly reddened, lashes a little damp; at most ONE thin, barely visible wet trail on one cheek, following the natural curve from the inner corner of the eye; matte natural skin elsewhere. NO thick glossy gel-like streaks, NO multiple parallel lines, NO shiny drawn-on drops, NO tears on both cheeks at once. [SETTING] Lighting: night, a single warm 3200K desk lamp making a pool of light on the desk, everything else dark, Rembrandt shadow on the face.  All papers, screens, signs, scrolls, plates and the noren curtain are completely blank and plain; no letters, numbers, crests or symbols anywhere in the frame; every wall is bare. SETTING: the place is reference image 2 ONLY; the background, furniture, lamps and lighting of reference image 1 must NOT appear. WALL RULE: every wall is completely bare — NO paper notices, NO posters, NO calendars, NO framed writing; NO noren curtain and NO hanging cloth unless the location reference shows one, and then it is plain solid indigo with NO circular crest. Inn kitchen / back office: whiteboards, labels, the wall calendar and every paper are completely blank; no notices on the walls. FRAMING FIRST: a tight single-person chest-up close-up — head and shoulders fill the frame, the top of the head near the top edge, the frame cut at mid-chest; the face occupies about one third of the frame height; hands NOT visible; NOT a medium shot, NOT a full-body shot. Full-frame 16:9 image, no black bars. Soft fill light keeps the mouth and jaw readable (lip-sync cut). Mouth gently closed or barely parted (speech is added later); natural skin texture, both eyes sharp and symmetrical in focus. [NEGATIVE] Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere in the image. gibberish, foreign text, incomprehensible letters, fake alphabets, blurry typography, text on badge, text on name tag, logo on shirt, brand logos, crest on noren, family emblem, signage lettering, posters with writing, paper notices on walls, printed labels, watermarks, stamps, symbols on collar, bad anatomy, deformed eyes, extra fingers, extra arms, duplicate people, anime, illustration.
